parameters.query: =SELECT co.id, co.source, co.external_ref, co.location_key, co.order_type, co.status, co.customer, co.items, co.payment, co.correlation_id, co.shipday_order_id, COALESCE(dl.is_active, true) AS location_active, COALESCE(dl.deliverect_active, false) AS deliverect_active, dl.name AS restaurant_name, dl.restaurant_address, dl.restaurant_phone, dl.gps_lat, dl.gps_lng, ro.raw_payload->>'restaurant_estimated_delivery_time' AS raw_est_delivery, ro.raw_payload->>'restaurant_estimated_pickup_time' AS raw_est_pickup FROM canonical_orders co LEFT JOIN dim_location dl ON dl.location_key = co.location_key LEFT JOIN raw_orders ro ON ro.id = co.raw_payload_id WHERE co.id = '{{ $json.canonical_id }}'::uuid;

=INSERT INTO public.order_state_history (canonical_order_id, from_state, to_state, reason, correlation_id) VALUES ('{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.id }}'::uuid, '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.status }}'::order_state, '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.status }}'::order_state, 'location_paused', NULLIF('{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.correlation_id }}', '')::uuid);
=SELECT decrypted_secret AS shipday_api_key FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name = 'shipday_api_key_' || '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.location_key }}' LIMIT 1;

=UPDATE canonical_orders SET shipday_order_id = '{{ $json.existing_shipday_order_id }}', shipday_pushed_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $json.canonical_id }}'::uuid; SELECT pgmq_delete_order('q_orders_push_shipday', {{ $json.msg_id }});

=UPDATE canonical_orders SET shipday_order_id = '{{ $json.shipday_order_id }}', shipday_pushed_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $json.canonical_id }}'::uuid; SELECT pgmq_delete_order('q_orders_push_shipday', {{ $json.msg_id }});

=SELECT pgmq_archive_order('q_orders_push_shipday', {{ $json.msg_id }}); INSERT INTO dlq_alerts (queue_name, msg_id, external_ref, source, location_key, canonical_order_id, last_error, attempt_count, alerted_at, created_at) VALUES ('q_orders_push_shipday', {{ $json.msg_id }}, '{{ $json.external_ref }}', 'shipday', '{{ $json.location_key }}', '{{ $json.canonical_id }}'::uuid, jsonb_build_object('message', 'Shipday push failed', 'code', '12401', 'stage', 'push_shipday'), 1, now(), now());
